senses.gloss: m. (תנב to become rigid, Brockelm. Lex. Syr.) stupor, loss of sensation.
units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 33:20">Targ. Job XXXIII, 20</cite>.—
<cite ref="Yoma 83a:3">Yoma 83ᵃ</cite> <he>ת׳ הוא דנקיט ליה</he> stupor seized him (so that he does not feel the lack of food).
<cite ref="Niddah 37b:36">Nidd. 37ᵇ</cite> <he>ת׳ בעלמא … לה</he> it is merely stupor that seized her (so that she feels no pain).
